per_layer_constraints.rule: If any selected layer specifies 800VDC, all layers in the power path (1, 3, 4) must be 800VDC-compatible.
If rack_density_kw >= 100, layer 5 must specify direct-to-chip liquid cooling, not air cooling alone.
If redundancy specifies '2N' at the utility level, layer 2 selection must include a utility-grade control/protection brand (EP2 or Crown), not Anord Mardix alone.
EPC Power is currently a pending acquisition (not yet closed). Any design relying on Layer 1 = EPC Power must flag this as a supply-timeline dependency.

cross_layer_compatibility.rule: Voltage architecture must be consistent from Layer 1 through Layer 4 — a design that mixes 800VDC at Layer 1 with 415VAC at Layer 4 without an explicit conversion stage is inconsistent.
Rack density (Layer 5 cooling capacity) must be able to support the power delivered per rack at Layer 4 — a mismatch here is a common design-time error.

cost_margin_notes: Combination designs spanning 4+ SpinCo brands typically carry higher integration cost but higher margin than single-brand designs, per historical SpinCo bundling patterns (AI Infrastructure Platform).
Designs depending on EPC Power (pending close) carry schedule risk that should be reflected as a cost/timeline contingency, not silently absorbed.

physical_rules._note: [Standard NEC/IEC Reference - Subject to SpinCo Line-Specific Validation] These are published generic-standard values, NOT SpinCo line-specific engineering limits. A SpinCo power engineer must confirm which standards and derating practice each product line designs against before production use.

continuous_load_derating.reference: NEC 210.20(A) - continuous loads sized at 125% of load, i.e. 80% usable capacity

assumed_power_factor.reference: Typical UPS output power factor; RFP did not state. Assumption, flagged.

assumed_branch_circuit_amps.reference: NEC 210.24 - common branch circuit rating where RFP does not specify

out_of_scope_for_solver.reason: Requires protection coordination and arc-flash study per IEEE 1584, not arithmetic
Requires thermal rise calculation and enclosure context; needs SpinCo line data
Requires CFD or manufacturer thermal models
